system.description:
Items are devices that enhance a character in some way or that serve useful tool, vehicle, base, or weapon.
Level 1: +1 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
Level 2: +2 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
Level 3: +3 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
Level 4: +4 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
Level 5: +5 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
Level 6: +6 bonus to appropriate Stat/Skill Group rolls
